characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to one of the following units: Cadian Shock Troops, Catachan Jungle Fighters, Krieg Combat Engineers, Tempestus Aquilons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, you can issue the Like the Wind! Order to a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit within 6" of this model. Until the end of the turn, that unit can move as if it had the Scouts 6" ability and its ranged weapons gain the **[ASSAULT]** ability. This is in addition to any other Orders issued by other **^^Officers^^**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During deployment, instead of placing this model (and its attached unit, if any) on the battlefield, you can place it in Strategic Reserves. In your Movement phase, you can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from enemy models. This may be used from the first battle round.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time the unit Al'Rahem leads Advances or Charges, you can re-roll the dice. This ability also applies if the attached unit benefits from the Like the Wind! Order this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this unit contains the Commander model and is within range of an objective marker, this unit can re-roll Battle-shock tests.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Commander model can be replaced with a single named **^^Astra Militarum Officer Character^^** at their own full points cost, wargear, and abilities (e.g. Captain Al'Rahem). When you do, the unit's cost becomes 35 points (the 4 Veteran Guardsmen only) plus the named Character's own points. The named Character occupies the Commander's role in this unit and issues Orders per their own datasheet (or this unit's Orders ability, whichever is more generous). Only one Officer may occupy this slot.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a model with a Regimental Standard is part of this unit, each time a friendly **^^Regiment^^** unit within 6" of this unit would take a Battle-shock test, it automatically passes.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a model with a Master Vox is part of this unit, Orders issued by an **^^Officer^^** to this unit, or by an **^^Officer^^** within this unit to another unit, can target friendly **^^Regiment^^** units within 12" instead of 6".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a model with a Medi-pack is part of this unit, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A Heavy Weapon Team takes the place of two Guardsmen.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or on unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if this unit is within 6" of one or more friendly **^^Regiment^^** units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: 6 models forming 3 Heavy Weapon Teams (2 models per team). Each team is equipped with one of: Heavy Bolter, Mortar, Missile Launcher, Lascannon, or Autocannon (mix-and-match freely).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within half range, that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

selectionEntries.name: Special Weapons Guardsman w/ Grenade launcher
Special Weapons Guardsman w/ Plasma gun

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, Hunting Lance attacks made by models in this unit have the **[LANCE]** and **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** abilities. This unit's Hunting Lances are used up after this combat — for the rest of the battle, replace the Hunting Lance profile with the Cavalry Sabre profile.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit has the Scouts 8" ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this unit declares a charge against a unit with 5 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

rules.name: Mechanised Doctrine
rules.description:
While a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit is embarked in a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^**, that unit adds 1 to its Objective Control characteristic (modifying the Transport's OC for purposes of objective contests).

Each time a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit disembarks from a Transport during your turn, until the end of that turn, ranged attacks made by models in that unit with the **[HEAVY]** ability are made at the firing model's full Ballistic Skill (the unit ignores the standard penalty for moving when firing Heavy weapons that turn).

Force Disposition: Sweep and Clear.

rules.name: Stratagem: Mechanised Spearhead (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Pre-game, after both armies have deployed but before the first turn begins. Use once per battle. **Target:** One friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** unit and its embarked unit. **Effect:** Redeploy that Transport (and its embarked unit) anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 18" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" from any enemy unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Open Hatches! (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Transport's embarked unit is selected to shoot using Firing Deck. **Target:** That embarked unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, increase the Transport's Firing Deck characteristic by 2. The embarked unit may also re-roll Wound rolls of 1 from these Firing Deck attacks.

rules.name: Stratagem: Treads Forward! (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Movement phase, just before a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** is selected to move. **Target:** That Transport. **Effect:** Add 3" to that Transport's Move characteristic until the end of the phase. In addition, if the Transport Advances this Movement phase, models embarked in it may still disembark this turn.

rules.name: Stratagem: Disembark and Fire! (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, after a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit that disembarked this turn is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's ranged attacks with the **[HEAVY]** ability gain the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hull-down Defense (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Start of your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** has been selected as the target of one or more attacks. **Target:** That Transport. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks targeting that Transport are subject to -1 to the Wound roll, and the Transport has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Smokescreen Surge (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** End of your Movement phase. **Target:** All friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transports^^** on the battlefield. **Effect:** Until the start of your next turn, those Transports gain the Stealth ability and the Benefit of Cover. Cannot be used by a Transport that Advanced this turn.
